Our experience and expertise allow us to offer a range of specialist services, all integrated to serve the needs and requirements of clients in the sectors in which we operate. We provide innovative structural design and analysis services to architects, owners, and developers for all types of buildings at all project phases.

We are involved in consulting projects across both the public and private sectors.

services.title: Structural Engineering
services.short_description: Comprehensive civil and structural engineering solutions for high-rise buildings and infrastructure.
services.description: We provide civil and structural engineering solutions for high-rise buildings, articulate structures, infrastructure projects, etc... our structural design team is located in seven zones of earthquake and snow is considered... We have strong engineering capabilities involving ETABS, SAP2000, SAFE, and STAAD Pro... modeling, international standards. The team has the expertise and is well-versed in many codes to perform analysis, design, and detailing of RCC, Structural Steel, Pre-stress Concrete, and Hybrid structures. It has the intent of excelling engineering as an outscoring outlet for many parts of the world with the most economical & tempestuous planning.

services.title: Structural Assessment and Rehabilitation
services.short_description: Thorough condition assessment, non-destructive testing, and retrofitting solutions.
services.description: Thorough condition assessment, non-destructive testing, distress diagnostics, and structural retrofitting solutions to enhance longevity and structural integrity for aged or compromised structures.

services.title: Structural Engineering Training
services.short_description: Industry-level structural design training for engineers.
services.description: Hands-on professional training programs for budding and practicing civil engineers covering modern analysis tools (ETABS, SAFE, STAAD Pro) and international design codes.

services.title: Project Management Consultancy
services.short_description: End-to-end execution supervision and project scheduling.
services.description: Strategic project planning, scheduling, vendor coordination, risk mitigation, and milestone tracking to ensure engineering projects are delivered within time and budget.

services.title: Quantity Survey
services.short_description: Precise BOQ preparation and cost estimation.
services.description: Detailed Bill of Quantities (BOQ), material estimation, rate analysis, and contract documentation for commercial, residential, and institutional developments.

services.title: Value Engineering Services
services.short_description: Optimization of structural systems without compromising safety.
services.description: Systematic design optimization reducing construction material costs while maintaining maximum safety, load efficiency, and architectural integrity.

services.title: Supervision of Construction
services.short_description: On-site quality audit and reinforcement inspection.
services.description: On-site quality assurance, compliance audits with structural drawings, reinforcement inspection, concrete cube test monitoring, and safety verification.

services.title: Rain Water Harvesting
services.description: Ecological design and structural engineering of storm-water catchments, recharge wells, filtration pits, and underground storage tanks.

services.title: Repair and Rehabilitation Services
services.short_description: Restoration of heritage and damaged structures.
services.description: Custom engineering repairs, micro-concreting, carbon-fiber wrapping, and crack injection for commercial and industrial structures.

services.title: Training Package
services.description: Comprehensive corporate training modules tailored for contractors, structural firms, and university graduates.
